handoffs.name: Splash reveals underwater
handoffs.mechanism: The impacting drop creates a rising wave/splash contour; the fish keeps moving behind the changing water coverage.

handoffs.name: Fish becomes leaf
handoffs.mechanism: One changing body outline, shrinking fins/eye, emerging veins, and a stalk growing from the former tail root.

handoffs.name: Petals assemble into butterfly
handoffs.mechanism: The same four petal paths change orientation and flap; the flower center elongates into the butterfly body.

handoffs.name: Butterfly folds into plane
handoffs.mechanism: The four wing paths flatten into paper facets while the same carrier continues on its authored path.

handoffs.name: Flight trail becomes orbit
handoffs.mechanism: The plane contracts into a star; its continuing trail reshapes into an ellipse around the rising moon.

artwork: Simple original authored SVG paths animated in Remotion; no image generation or reused singularity imagery.
review_notes: Representative encoded frames and transitional sequences inspected. Scene/hand-off sheets are spaced samples, not every source frame. GIF is a silent 20fps proxy with an artificial loop restart. Technical checks do not establish a creative pass.
